title: Sollang lazy sequence iterator transforms focused contract

evaluation.const: pull-fused at each; no eager adapter execution

materialization.const: no adapter-owned element collection, realloc, memcpy, or memmove; bounded first-class producer contexts are not element materialization

earlyStop.const: take stops the complete upstream pipeline, including nested and concurrent producers

state.const: take, skip, and scan state persists once per pipeline instance

callbacks.const: compile-time typed blocks with concrete input and output types; no indirect callback dispatch

firstClassStreams.const: zip stops at the shortest input; latest retains one bounded current value per input and downstream cancellation joins producers

acceptance.const: managed Windows focused native and LLVM evidence only; selfhost and other platforms pending
